log_file.description: Path to a file where AutoSSH logs will be written. If empty, uses syslog or stderr.

ssh_options.description: List of additional command-line options to pass to the underlying ssh command (e.g., ['-N', '-T', '-o ServerAliveInterval=30'] ).

env_vars.description: Custom environment variables for advanced use cases (e.g., proxy configuration). Keys are variable names, values are their string values.
